sql: SELECT y.trip_date, y.avg_trip_distance, y.avg_total_amount, CASE WHEN y.trip_date = DATE '2024-11-28' THEN 'target' ELSE 'baseline' END AS day_type FROM whybot.yellow_daily y WHERE y.trip_date IN (DATE '2024-11-07', DATE '2024-11-14', DATE '2024-11-21', DATE '2024-11-28') ORDER BY y.trip_date LIMIT 500
